Title: Awesome SEO for Umbraco
Description: SEO report and action plan inside the Umbraco backoffice. Crawls your site and up to 5 competitors on a schedule, runs 40 SEO checks, gives a technical SEO score weighted by ranking impact, shows what changed since last time, compares you side by side with your competitors and builds a prioritised action plan with links straight to the pages in Umbraco. Free and works without any external service. Optional AI (Claude and/or Jev by TypeSafe) explains the changes and makes the plan concrete, with a monthly USD cap. Dashboard UI in Danish.
